---
title: "Baseball, by the Numbers"
---

Welcome to a data-driven exploration of Major League Baseball history. Using the Lahman database, this site shows how the apparent home-run collapses of shortened seasons become much less dramatic when measured as home runs per team-game rather than raw totals.

The site also highlights baseball's career home-run leaders and takes a closer look at Barry Bonds's season-by-season record. Use the analysis pages in the navbar to explore the numbers and the players behind them.
